source.title: Sheet Pan Harissa Chicken & Chickpeas
source.text:
Sheet Pan Harissa Chicken & Chickpeas — one tray, no fuss, and the chickpeas go crisp at the edges while the chicken finishes. Weeknight food that looks like you tried.

Serves 3

Ingredients
6 bone-in chicken thighs
2 cans chickpeas, drained and patted dry
1 red onion, cut into wedges
3 tbsp harissa paste
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp ground cumin
3/4 tsp flaky sea salt
a handful of coriander, roughly chopped

Method
1. Heat the oven to 220C fan.
2. Toss the chickpeas and onion with the oil, harissa and cumin.
3. Roast 35 minutes, until the skin is dark.
